OUR STORY

湖北欧阳聚德汽车有限公司 · Hubei Ouyang Jude Automobile Co., Ltd.

Founded 2017 in Zaoyang · 6 Series Covering All Major Trailers · T700C High-Strength Steel · 30+ Provinces Served

Hubei Ouyang Jude Automobile Co., Ltd., founded in 2017 and headquartered in Zaoyang, Hubei Province, specializes in the R&D, manufacturing and sales of semi-trailers, cargo trucks and special-purpose export vehicles. Spread across 120,000 m² with 200+ employees, the company is the authorized first-tier dealer of Shaanxi Heavy Duty Automobile in the Xiangyang region, and an industry-academia R&D partner with Huazhong University of Science & Technology, Hubei University of Technology and Xiangyang Polytechnic.

The company integrates R&D, design, manufacturing, sales and after-sales into one full-chain service. Certified by ISO 9001 and CCC, our 'Xiangqi' and 'Chuyuan' brand vehicles are listed in the National Vehicle Product Catalog. We also undertake national-level key equipment projects, holding the relevant qualifications and quality system certifications.

MISSION

To deliver high-quality, trusted transport equipment to the global logistics industry.

VISION

To be a company customers trust and employees take pride in.

MILESTONES

Company Milestones

Built one trailer, one customer, one milestone at a time

2017

Founded · Shaanxi Authorized Dealer

Founded in Zaoyang, Hubei. In the same year, recognized by Shaanxi Heavy Duty as an authorized dealer and 'Hubei Regional Market Breakthrough' awardee — becoming the first-tier dealer in Xiangyang region.

2018

'Workpoint System' Launched · Shaanxi Market Breakthrough Award

Introduced the 'Workpoint System' — a 1-to-9-star employee tier with transparent evaluation. Awarded 'Hubei Regional Market Breakthrough' by Shaanxi Heavy Duty. The 'Jude Spirit' company culture took shape from this year.

2019

Xiangyang Logistics Vice-Chair · Truck-Home Digital Marketing Award

Elected Vice-Chairman of Xiangyang Logistics Industry Association. Won 'Annual Best Digital Marketing Innovation' from Truck-Home, our first national-level brand recognition.

2020

National Key Equipment Projects · Production Breakthrough

Established the dedicated R&D group for national-level key equipment projects. Annual sales exceeded 1,996 units; annual production exceeded 1,919 units. Obtained the World Manufacturer Identifier (WMI) certificate.

2021

High-Tech Enterprise · Gazelle · Hubei University R&D Base

A breakthrough year of three national/provincial recognitions: Certified High-Tech Enterprise, named '2021 Gazelle Enterprise', and signed the joint R&D base with Hubei University of Technology.

2022

Provincial 'Little Giant' SRDI Enterprise

Recognized by Hubei Province as a 'Specialized, Refined, Differentiated, Innovative (SRDI) Little Giant' enterprise. Selected into the Hubei IT-Industrialization Integration Pilot.

2023

Triple Recognition · Tax · Safety · Logistics

Three official designations: 'Outstanding Tax Contribution', 'Annual Safety-Production Outstanding Unit', and 'Xiangyang Logistics Equipment Service Advanced Unit'.

2024

Provincial Smart Manufacturing Pilot · AAA Credit Enterprise

Awarded 'Provincial Smart Manufacturing Pilot Enterprise'. Recognized as 'AAA Contract-and-Credit-Honoring Enterprise'. Joined the Zaoyang Automotive & Parts Industry IP Alliance.

2025

Green Factory · Specialty Smart Factory · Digital Transformation Tier-2

Three provincial designations from Hubei Dept. of Economy & IT: 'Provincial Green Factory', 'Specialty Logistics Vehicle Smart Manufacturing Factory', and 'Provincial Digital Transformation Tier-2'.

2026

Provincial SME Tech Center · World Manufacturer Code 3416a · New Website Online

Recognized as 'Hubei Provincial SME Technology Center'. Awarded World Manufacturer Code 3416a. New website online: configurator + real-time DingTalk inquiry pipeline.
